chapter_title: Concerning the Purification of these Four Elements
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Core Text

---

** ¶2:** The four fundamental fac ulties of the spiritual mind — love, understanding, perception, and out ward expression — are what undergo purification. From their origin they are holy, living, and illumin ating, for they flow from the Divine and part ake of its nature . But when these faculties entered into the prim ordial conflict between good and evil, the waste of falsity was com mingled with them, and the darkness of hell became ent angled in their substance . When at last they descended into the external natural man , they began to cast off the falsified external tru ths that had adhered to them — those corrupted cov erings they had assumed — and depos ited them into the selfhood. These rejected corru ptions, once stripped away and made visible, become a source of spiritual danger to the whole natural mind , for they persist there as active ev ils.

**¶3:** The corruption that self -love exp els and deposits into the natural man is the vitiation of spiritual life itself. From vit iated spiritual life proceeds w rath. From wrath proceed disordered affections that perv ade the entire natural mind.

**¶4:** The corru ptions that perv erted truths release from themselves are the cravings of the sens ual mind. From sens ual cr aving proceeds spiritual b itterness and accusation. From bitterness proceeds an inflamed and agitated state that cons umes the whole natural person .

**¶5:** The corruption that wisdom, when dark ened, expels is the proprium — the selfhood claimed as one 's own. From the proprium proceeds spiritual obscurity. From spiritual obscurity proceeds the hardening of the will against all divine influx.

**¶ 6:** The corruptions that perception exp els are the rest less thoughts born of spiritual exposure and self-cond emnation. From these thoughts of shame proceeds — *( the text breaks off; but by the pattern , a still deeper disorder of the mind's out ward life would follow , likely spiritual paral ysis or mut eness — the inability to express any good ) .*

**¶7:** Grief and contrition constitute the *(the text is too fragment ary for certainty, but the correspondence suggests that ) * turning - point or summ ation of all twelve corruptions — the moment when the awareness of all these spiritual diseases becomes a single suffering that opens the way to regener ation.

**¶8:** These four spiritual faculties, once they receive what the Lord's providence g athers and introduces as n ourishment for the interior life — the good and truth that enter the natural man through instruction and tem ptation — are progress ively cleansed, purified, and re -established in their living form, which is the regenerate person. They come alive in a new way and receive the Divine Rational — the understanding illumin ated directly by the Lord — and are restored to their true image. They emerge from the natural man wholly cle ansed and sanct ified, and attain at last their original heavenly peace: the celest ial state from which they first descended.

However, when they undertood [the onslaught of the darkness] in that first struggle, the waste was [mixed] in with them, and the darkness of the enemy was mixed with them. And when they were come into the body, stripping off these polluted garments, they set them in the flesh. Their pollutions, which they have stripped off, shall be displayed in a [dark image] and become a danger to the body.
The discharge of this pollution, that [the fir]e shall disgorge and place in the body, is [blo]od. The discharge of the blood is anger. The discharge of anger is the humours.
Also, the emissions that the waters discharge from them are lust. The discharge of lust is bitterness. The emission of bitterness is f[e]ver.
The emission that light shall disgorge is flesh. The emission of flesh is gloom. [The] emission of gloom is obstinacy.
The emission of the [tear] is the [gathering] of these twelve emissions.

[Now] these four elements shall [be purified, and] what are gathered in are [f]ound by the management of this soul food [that] enters the body. When they enter the body, they are cleansed and purified and established [i]n their living image, which is the new man. They shall live [anew] and receive the Light Mind and be purified in their image; and they come forth, being cleansed and holy. They attain their first rest.
